lines.text: 你难道不知道，在军中总要两害相权取其轻——在两只象鼻虫里挑小的那只？
lines.en: Do you not know that in the service one must always choose the lesser of two weevils?
lines.character: 杰克·奥布里舰长 / Capt. Jack Aubrey
